items.title: Houston Person Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995…
items.q: There was Aaron Harvey, Bobby Ephraim, in my early association with them at South Carolina State, and the South Carolina State College Band, which took me on

ctx.x: These guys were all great players then. I was just starting out. So they helped me a great deal in my early years, helping me get myself together and being very tolerant of course. They took me under their wings and helped me a lot. In fact, the basis of my whole playing, my approach, goes back to those guys. There was Aaron Harvey, Bobby Ephraim, in my early association with them at South Carolina State, and the South Carolina State College Band, which took me on and I didn’t know a thing, they just helped me…
Were you always a tenor player?
